authority.precedence: Product Truth and the canonical docs above win over these tokens; tokens never authorize changing a product.

accents.method: approximate colour sampling from 1080px thumbnails of the four published posts; not taken from a master brand file
accents.rule: one accent per composition; the accent follows the product. These samples are matching references, not a fixed palette.

brandMark.identity: navy field with warm gold / ivory logo
brandMark.scope: logo and brand mark only; not the default feed background
brandMark.hexStatus: missing: owner to supply (sample from the master logo asset once committed; do not sample from screenshots)

scene.rule: the scene changes only around the real product; product pixels stay source pixels

chips.content: one verified fact about this product per chip

layout.mobileReadability: headline legible on the phone-size preview and in the feed grid crop; subhead and chips legible at full-screen phone size; outside platform UI safe zones

product.rule: text, rule, chips and insets never cover or overpower the product; the product stays the largest single element
